notificationRecordCompatibility: native-chat-notifications-v1 and preference/event/receipt codecs unchanged; sound IDs retain existing default|none|*.caf syntax
inventory: NativeChatNotificationSoundLibrary.binaryInventory(raw) maps all active/staged/retired descriptors; requiredBinaries(raw) names active mandatory binaries
binaryValidator: NativeChatNotificationSoundLibrary.validateBinary(item, bytes) validates exact SHA, byte size, normalized WAV shape and frame count
storage: Existing NativeSessionStorage encrypted binary v4 and authenticated text v3; no extra key or plaintext persistent library

export.active: Every required binary must exist and match descriptor; never skip unknown/damaged audio
export.stagedRetired: Keep exact descriptors. Their bytes may be absent only because an uncommitted import/deletion has not completed. Existing bytes must validate; corrupt/unknown bytes reject and remain untouched. Do not promote staged items or reselect retired items.
export.builtins: Versioned immutable v1 APK assets; do not export runtime-generated samples or a second device key

import.owner: P7 migration only; P9 supplies schema and validators, not another migrator
import.idsAndBytes: Retain imported IDs, descriptors and normalized SHA/bytes, re-encrypt with destination installation key through existing migration publication
import.permissions: Do not restore source URI, URI grants, source provider identity, player/focus state, system sound URI overrides or Android notification permission/channels as app-owned truth
import.notificationReset: Existing migration contract still forces notifications off/new registration generation. Preserve original events/receipts as immutable archive, never re-post. Sound reference repair must touch only sound references and preserve those receipts.
import.provider: Build stable URI from destination applicationId plus validated local normalized hash; register non-exported grant-only provider locally and verify real system read. No source absolute paths.
import.pending: Keep index/binary relation until exact validated cleanup; pending descriptors do not become active sounds on import or cold read
import.missingReferences: Missing or unsupported imported references require explicit repair/reset to default/inherit through the migration owner; current runtime fails unavailable rather than silently substituting a sound

implemented: Local library/read/import/delete/staged settlement only. Full migration integration and cross-install permission/URI/system tests remain parent-owned.
